title: Refine Sketchpad Tree Sibling Spacing
description: Refine the shared sketchpad tree spacing so that whenever a sibling transition goes from a leaf/property row to an expandable/group row at the same depth, one empty-row-sized gap is inserted before the group row. Apply this generically based on row kind and sibling transition, preserve compact spacing within consecutive property rows, hierarchy, tree lines, value-column layout, and row actions. Extend existing tests and make them pass.
summary: Follow-up fix for the shared sketchpad tree spacing: the previous generic gap rule did not apply to details-panel transitions like Color -> Center because raw TreeRow wrappers were not treated as sibling rows by the branch spacing engine. Updated elements/ui so TreeRow emits a generic row kind (property/content), TreeBranchContent recognizes tree-row siblings, and hover-path row matching includes tree-row. This lets same-depth property/leaf -> group transitions receive the intended empty-row-sized gap generically without field-name special cases. Added UI tests covering TreeRow row-kind emission. Verified @elements/ui:test passes (35/35) and @compose/ui:test passes (253/253). @semio-tech/compose-sketchpad:test remains blocked by the existing Playwright CSS-loader issue (Unknown file extension .css for @xyflow/react/dist/style.css, then No tests found).
